description: Create a social media post. Can create a draft, schedule for later, or publish immediately. Supports all platforms: LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky. For threads, set isThread to true and separate posts with double line breaks (\n\n) in the text.

isThread.description: Set to true for Twitter/Bluesky/Threads threads. Split text with \n\n.

media.description: Optional media attachments. Use URLs from upload_media.

platformContent.description: Optional per-platform text overrides. Keys are platform names.

platforms.description: Array of platforms to post to

publishNow.description: Set to true to publish immediately instead of creating a draft.

schedule.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime to schedule the post (e.g. 2026-04-15T09:00:00Z). Omit for draft.

text.description: The post content. For threads, separate each post with \n\n

name: create_post
